_meta.purpose: Vampire persona + earnest/sardonic axis.  Tone axis modulating sincerity vs ironic distance.  Vampire is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4).  Question mix: 5 earnest-trait sincere value-prompts + 5 sardonic-trait commentary-on-modern-life prompts + 2 extraction power-questions + 2 hand-written.

hand_written: something most people say with a straight face but secretly know is false (sardonic-prompted)
